question: Which of the following is a part of a leaf?
solution:
The correct answer is __Petiole.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Leaves are the parts of a plant that absorb sunlight which is vital for the process of photosynthesis.
 
• 
 
Leaves have two main parts: The leaf blade and the Stalk or the petiole

 
 
• 
 
The leaf blade__: It is also called the lamina and is usually broad and flat. It is in this layer that photosynthesis occurs.

 
 
• 
 
It contains a prominent midrib at the center of the leaf blade which is the main vein. From this midrib arise branches called veins.

 
 
• 
 
They are of different types depending upon the type of edges, the pattern of the veins, and the number of blades per leaf.

 
 
• 
 
 __The Petiole__: It is the stalk-like structure in the leaf that forms the link between the leaf blade to the stem. It has tiny tubes, that connect the veins on the leaf blade to the stem. Some of these veins facilitate the transport of water to the leaf while other one carries the food away from the leaf to other parts of the plant.

 
 
• 
 
Some plants also contain another part called__ Stipules __which are small flap-like structures that grow at the base of the petioles in order to protect the petioles when they are growing.
